answer: Ripple's Unique Node List gives a sybil swarm nowhere to land. First, each agent trusts a published list of about 35 validators, each bound to a verified domain and a named operator. Second, joining the list takes six months of 99% uptime plus review by list publishers. Third, a ledger entry counts only when 80% of the list signs it; unlisted keys are ignored. Flipping a result needs 28 seats: 28 vetted firms paying $400/month for servers over six months, about $67,200, while a million fake nodes buy zero votes. Sybils are a painted island on a chart: sailors steer by the known reef.
